current_answer: OpenAI plugins are installable packages of reusable task instructions, tool connections or both. The universal directory distributes them for supported hosts; it does not grant universal execution, provider access or customer value. Choose the smallest useful architecture and actual channel, then inspect the boundary that blocks your next task. Publication is separate from approval, enhanced main-page placement and intended-recipient install/selection/use; exact results remain unobserved here.
